Answers below.

---

**h01** — S3 presign refresh runner — every 12 hours (plus one immediate run at startup) — wired in `server/server.go:162-171` (inside `startBackgroundRunners`, called from `Start` at `server/server.go:129`)

- Component: `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), whose `RunOnce`→`CheckAndPresign` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43,47`) re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before they expire.
- Schedule: `const runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:30`), ticker loop in `Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:32-41`).

**h02** — delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual HTTP send at `:152`, `safeClient.Do(req)`); protection: SSRF guard at dial time — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) installed as the `http.Transport.DialContext` of the shared `safeClient` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-37`), which rejects any resolved IP matched by `isReservedIP` against `reservedCIDRs` (loopback, RFC-1918, 169.254.0.0/16 IMDS, IPv6 equivalents) — `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`. Because the check happens at dial, it also defeats DNS rebinding. A second, earlier check is `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) at webhook-registration time (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`). Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`).

**h03** — abstraction: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:1-8`, defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`); implementation: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20` `IdentityProvider`, constructed by `NewIdentityProvider` at `:27`). OAuth2 is the only concrete protocol implementation shipped.

**h04** — no. Evidence: `mysql.NewDB` is defined at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20` and the only reference to it anywhere is `store/db/db.go:22` inside the `NewDBDriver` switch. Repo-wide, the only file importing `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` is `store/db/db.go:8`. Within-package composite literals `&DB{}` exist only in mysql's own tests (`store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`), not in production code outside the factory.

**h05** — mechanism: explicit Go code (two `DELETE FROM reaction` statements per driver), inside the delete-user transaction. There is no database-level rule.

- Explicit deletes: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (deletes reactions on the user's memo tree, keyed `memos/<uid>`) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (deletes reactions the user authored), invoked from `deleteUserTargetsTx`:
  - `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102` (impls at `:380`, `:400`)
  - `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102` (impls at `:380`, `:400`)
  - `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102` (impls at `:417`, `:437`)
- No DB-level rule: the `reaction` table declares no FOREIGN KEY / ON DELETE CASCADE in any dialect — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-98`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-97`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`. (Additionally SQLite is opened with FK constraints off — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:39-40`.)

**h06** — handlers (all `APIV1Service` RPC methods):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (dispatch at `:157`)
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, `:513` → `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` (dispatch at `:562`)
- `SetMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` (`:48`)
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` (`:48`)
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` (`:119`)

Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`. All paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) onto `asyncPostQueue`, whose 4 worker goroutines (`:42-55`) call `Post`, the sole place the outbound request is issued.

**h07**
- Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` (checks `userCache` only on ID lookups; this is a username lookup, so it falls through) — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers`
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (default driver sqlite) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`, SELECT incl. `avatar_url` at `:152`
- Back in the handler: `FileServerService.parseDataURI` decodes the stored `avatar_url` data URI — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`, served via `c.Blob` at `:208`

**h08** — 2 declarers.
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked? **yes** — `server/server.go:163` (`startBackgroundRunners`) and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (its own `Run` ticker loop)
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? **no** — no callers anywhere (production or test); only the package-level helper `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`

**h09** — count: 6 concrete declarations (plus 2 interface declarations: `store.Driver.Close` at `store/driver.go:12` and `cache.Interface.Close` at `store/cache/cache.go:31`).

Concrete declarations and invocation status (all 6 are reached from non-test server code):
- `*store.Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72` — called by `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `*cache.Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — called by `store/store.go:74,75,76`
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67` — called via `s.driver.Close()` at `store/store.go:78` (this is the one that runs by default)
- `*mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — same call site, `store/store.go:78`, when `--driver=mysql`
- `*postgres.DB.Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46` — same call site, `store/store.go:78`, when `--driver=postgres`
- `*SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — called by `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)

**h10** — `NewEngine` — `internal/filter/engine.go` — ~32 callers. Caveat worth stating: the fan-in is overwhelmingly test-driven — 30 of the 33 textual occurrences are in `internal/filter/{engine,functions,time}_test.go`; only 3 are non-test. Runner-up is `NewSchema` (`internal/filter/schema.go`, ~29).

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` (11 packages outside `store/`); 2nd: `store.Memo` (10 packages).

- `store.User`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `store/db/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}`, `store/test`
- `store.Memo`: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`, `store/db/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}`, `store/test`
- Next tier: `store.Attachment` (8), `store.Inbox` / `store.MemoRelation` / `store.MemoShare` (7 each)

**h12** — concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, INSERT statement built and executed at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-42`.

Determination method: the call is behind the `store.Driver` interface (`Store.CreateMemo` → `s.driver.CreateMemo`, `store/memo.go:113`), so I resolved the dynamic dispatch by tracing driver selection. `NewDBDriver` switches on `profile.Driver` (`store/db/db.go:18-27`), and with no flags that value defaults to `"sqlite"` — `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` at `cmd/memos/main.go:122` and the flag default at `cmd/memos/main.go:130`. So the `case "sqlite"` branch (`store/db/db.go:20`) constructs `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:24`), fixing the concrete receiver. The mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` implementations are unreachable in that configuration.

**h13** — impl: the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`), the only implementation of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`).

- Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`. The single production construction site is `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` enabled. (Other calls are test-only: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`, `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`.)
- Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected from the APIV1 instance at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`); also passed as a parameter to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14** — computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which delegates to `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:33`, single-pass goldmark AST walk; property computation in `ExtractProperties`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:188`).

- Triggers: `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`; `UpdateMemo` when the content field changes — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`. (`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`, would bulk-recompute for all memos but is never invoked — see h08.)
- Extracted properties: written to `memo.Payload` — `Tags` (deduplicated `#tag` list) and `Property` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:85-86`), where `MemoPayload.Property` carries `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` (`proto/store/memo.proto:16-19`; `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:127-155`).

**h15** — enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read on the gRPC/Connect API) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility filter injection — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-226`
- `APIV1Service.ListUserStats` / user-stats visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90,218-220`
- `FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` (HTTP file/attachment serving, incl. share-token fallback) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650,677,699`
- `APIV1Service.checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422,445,451`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:200,214,222`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoReactions` and `UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:15,30,38` and `:83`
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20,41`
- `SSEClient.canReceive` (server-side SSE event filtering) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:133-143`
- RSS feeds, hard-restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- Sitemap, hard-restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Mention/notification fan-out suppression — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62,67`, `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`, `server/notification/email.go:313-316`

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in this codebase (no `redis` import, dependency, or config — nothing in `go.mod`). Actual mechanism: an in-process, in-memory cache. `store.Store` holds three `*cache.Cache` instances — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` (`store/store.go:27-29`), all built in `store.New` from one config with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:40-53`). So user entries expire after 10 minutes, with a sweep every 5 minutes. Implementation: `store/cache/cache.go` (map + mutex + background cleanup goroutine; `Interface` at `:10`, `Close` at `:187`). Cache reads/writes for users are at `store/user.go:143,150,167`; invalidation on delete at `store/user_delete.go:39-47`.

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware in this codebase, so there are no request limits to report. The complete set of Echo middleware registrations is `middleware.Recover()` and `newCORSMiddleware(profile)` (`server/server.go:51-52`), plus static-file and SPA-fallback middleware on the frontend (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54,59`). Request-path authorization is done by the auth interceptor/`Authorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66-68`, `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`), not by rate limiting. No `golang.org/x/time/rate`, limiter, or throttle code exists. The only concurrency bounds are semaphores on thumbnail/image processing (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:38-39,60-61`) and the 128-slot webhook dispatch queue (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) — resource guards, not per-user rate limits.

**r03** — Premise is wrong: no nightly database-cleanup job exists, and no cron scheduler is running. A cron scheduler package does exist (`internal/scheduler/`, with `ParseCronExpression` at `internal/scheduler/parser.go:30` and `Scheduler.Start/Register/Stop` in `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`), but it is entirely unwired: the only files importing `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/scheduler` are its own tests (`internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`, `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`). No job is ever registered, so there is no schedule time. The only background work the server actually starts is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker (`server/server.go:153-172`) — not a cleanup job and not cron-scheduled.

**r04** — Premise is wrong on both options: there is no message broker at all — no NATS, no RabbitMQ, no AMQP client (nothing in `go.mod`, no imports), and consequently no queue declaration. Actual mechanism: an in-process buffered Go channel. `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 goroutines started in `package init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `webhook.Post` (`:120`). Producers call `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`), which does a non-blocking send and **drops** the payload with a warning when the buffer is full (`:189-195`). This is process-local and non-durable: queued webhooks are lost on restart.

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema, server, or dependency in this codebase (no `.graphql` files, no resolver code, no GraphQL library in `go.mod`). Actual public API surface: Protobuf-defined gRPC services exposed over **Connect RPC** and a **gRPC-Gateway** REST/JSON mapping. Schemas live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` — `memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `common.proto` — with generated Go in `proto/gen/api/v1/`. Registration happens in `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64`) plus `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` and `connect_services.go`. Non-RPC HTTP surfaces are the file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go:66-68`), and MCP (`server/router/mcp/`).
